all_reforms_including_excluded.description: The introduction of the 'brownfield' programme aimed to reduce the burden of potential Superfund liability on developers of contaminated land, facilitating urban regeneration in poorer districts.
all_reforms_including_excluded.growth_orientation_rationale: By alleviating liability concerns, the programme encourages investment in urban areas, potentially leading to economic revitalization and increased property values.
all_reforms_including_excluded.status_evidence: Some regeneration projects have subsequently succeeded, though take-up has been less than hoped.
all_reforms_including_excluded.importance_rationale: The programme represents a significant effort to address urban decay and promote sustainable development, although its impact has been limited.
all_reforms_including_excluded.source_quote: The 'brownfield' programme was thought to be a factor impeding urban regeneration, particularly in poorer districts.
all_reforms_including_excluded.cross_verification_note: The description focuses on reducing liability for developers and facilitating urban regeneration, which does not directly relate to R&D funding or knowledge transfer.

all_reforms_including_excluded.description: The introduction of emissions trading under the Clean Air Act represents an innovative approach to pollution control, allowing for the trading of emission permits to meet specific targets.
all_reforms_including_excluded.package_name: Clean Air Act Emissions Trading Program
all_reforms_including_excluded.growth_orientation_rationale: Emissions trading encourages cost-effective pollution reduction, fostering innovation in pollution control technologies and practices.
all_reforms_including_excluded.status_evidence: The SO trading system has been in operation since 1992.
all_reforms_including_excluded.importance_rationale: The emissions trading program represents a significant shift in environmental policy, moving from command-and-control regulations to market-based mechanisms, which has had a substantial impact on reducing emissions.
all_reforms_including_excluded.source_quote: A particularly innovative approach to pollution control – emissions trading– has been introduced in two programmes under the Clean Air Act.
all_reforms_including_excluded.cross_verification_note: The reform pertains to emissions trading for pollution control, which is not an R&D funding mechanism or innovation instrument for firms in the context of deep-tech or R&D-intensive sectors.
